name: Stepped OD Profile
description: Simple stepped OD profile with two diameters and face from centerline. Tests face zone, multi-level roughing, and step transitions.

roughing_boundary.description: Profile offset outward by fin_allowance_radius (0.001). Roughing stops here.

stock_boundary.description: Rectangle from centerline to stock radius, Z_start to Z_end

closure_segments.description: OD mode: profile_end to centerline at Z_end, up centerline to Z=0

true_face_zone.description: Rectangle from X_start to Stock_radius, Z=0 to Z_start

finished_part.description: Area enclosed by profile + closure (between profile and centerline)

material_to_rough.description: Area between stock boundary and roughing boundary

finish_allowance_zone.description: Thin band between roughing boundary and profile boundary (0.001 inch wide)
